query: SELECT tool FROM (SELECT tool,calls FROM rollup_tool_hourly WHERE project_id=$1 AND hour>=$4 AND hour<$5 UNION ALL SELECT tool,1 AS calls FROM events WHERE project_id=$1 AND type='tool.called' AND tool IS NOT NULL AND ts>=$2 AND ts<$3 AND (ts<$4 OR ts>=$5)) totals GROUP BY tool ORDER BY sum(calls) DESC,tool LIMIT 5
